title: Foundations: The Verdant Pack
description: The first of many mods that adds and expands on vanilla-like or vanilla features! This one expands on the luck potion and the unused Illusioner mob.
body:
**_This is the beginning mod to a new series called Foundations. The series will expand and add vanilla-like features._**

# Clover Valley
As a new biome that spawns in the world, it's lucky green coloring will make it a unique find. You can find any basic mobs such as cows, pigs, sheep, chickens, and even a new greenish wolf varient called "Clover". 
![The new Clover variant standing next to an oak tree in the Clover Valley biome.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6ccd5633ba154025b78c36452164ac75b775d1b1.png)

Within the biome, you can find a new plant called a Clover. When harvested, it drops a _Rooted Clover_ (Resembles a three-leaf clover). However, you have a 1/2000 chance to get a _Rooted Lucky Clover_ (Resembles a four-leaf clover). After obtaining a Rooted Lucky Clover, you will get an advancement titled "_One in Ten Thousand_". The reason for this is because in real life, thats the chance of finding a four leaf clover. 

**Fun Fact!**
Originally I did have the chance set to 1/10,000 but after lots of testing and having over 20 double chests worth of Rooted Clovers, I realized it was too difficult. 

# Illusioner
That's right! The Illusioner mob will spawn in the darkness of the Clover Valley so beware. After death, you will be rewarded with Emeralds and a chance for a new music disc to drop: bird.

# What's the Point?
What's the point of what? Going to the biome? Well after obtaining a Rooted Lucky Clover, you will be able to brew a Luck Potion. The potion will allow you to fish for better loot and have better chances when looting naturally generated chests. (You can also find a Rooted Lucky Clover by a Sniffer).
